Options: 
A. They are more robust and flexible
B. They are based on homogeneity of variance
C. They are used for ordinal and nominal data
D. They are less sensitive to outliers
E. They do not assume an underlying population distribution
F. They are based on Independence of Observations
G. They are based on normal distribution
H. They can be used when data is not normally distributed
I. They are used when the sample size is small

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
